# ankra_registry_retention (Resource)

The organisation's image retention on the Ankra registry: which images it keeps, so it can bring its storage down itself. One per organisation. The counterpart of `ankra registry storage retention set` and `ankra registry storage retention rule add|remove`.

This resource owns the whole policy and rule list: rules added outside Terraform show as drift and are removed on the next apply. Creating it refuses to overwrite a policy or rules the organisation already set; import them instead. Every save sends the version Terraform last read, so a change someone made in between is refused instead of overwritten. Destroying the resource restores the platform default and removes every rule.

Retention deletes images. Two protections hold whatever is set: at least the newest image of every repository is kept, and an organisation-set policy also keeps every image pulled within the last week.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_registry_retention" "this" {
  default = {
    keep_days   = 30
    keep_latest = 10
  }

  rules = [
    {
      repository_pattern = "ankra-ci/**"
      keep_days          = 0
      keep_latest        = 3
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Attributes) The organisation's project-wide policy. Unset uses the platform default, which keeps nothing a repository rule could narrow, so `rules` need it set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default))
- `rules` (Attributes Set) Per-repository policies (at most 50). A repository a rule matches follows that rule instead of `default`; when rules overlap, the most specific pattern decides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `default_in_force` (Attributes) The project-wide policy in force: `default`, or the platform default while it is unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_in_force))
- `id` (String) Always `registry_retention`.
- `platform_default` (Attributes) The platform default policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platform_default))
- `source` (String) `organisation` when `default` is set, `default` while the platform default applies.
- `version` (String) Opaque version of the stored policy and rules, sent back on every save.

<a id="nestedatt--default"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default`

Required:

- `keep_days` (Number) Keep every image pushed within this many days (0 to 3650; 0 turns this rule off).
- `keep_latest` (Number) Keep this many most recently pushed images of each repository, whatever their age (1 to 1000).


<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `keep_days` (Number) Keep every image pushed within this many days (0 to 3650; 0 turns this rule off).
- `keep_latest` (Number) Keep this many most recently pushed images of each repository, whatever their age (1 to 1000).
- `repository_pattern` (String) Repository path pattern inside the registry project, lowercase, where `*` matches within a path segment and `**` across segments (for example `ankra-ci/**`).

Optional:

- `application_id` (String) Application the rule was made for, if any: a lower-case UUID.


<a id="nestedatt--default_in_force"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_in_force`

Read-Only:

- `keep_days` (Number) Keep every image pushed within this many days (0 to 3650; 0 turns this rule off).
- `keep_latest` (Number) Keep this many most recently pushed images of each repository, whatever their age (1 to 1000).


<a id="nestedatt--platform_default"></a>
### Nested Schema for `platform_default`

Read-Only:

- `keep_days` (Number) Keep every image pushed within this many days (0 to 3650; 0 turns this rule off).
- `keep_latest` (Number) Keep this many most recently pushed images of each repository, whatever their age (1 to 1000).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one retention per organisation; any ID imports it.
terraform import ankra_registry_retention.this registry_retention
```
